per_query_caveat: Upstream 0.2.0's query() calls maybe_generate_packing_keys() on EVERY query — there is no session or key-cache API. Raven's fork added pir/session.rs (ClientSession + a packing-key pre-exchange handshake, keys uploaded once and referenced by handle). So client_query_gen_ms and query_bytes for this row include per-query InspiRING key generation and shipping, while inspire-raven's do not. That is a real difference between the implementations, not a harness artifact — but the two per-query numbers are not measuring the same work, and any comparison must say so.
notes: The pre-fork baseline. github.com/igor53627/inspire-rs — the upstream that inspire-raven and inspire-lianghuiqiang9 both descend from — has been DELETED from GitHub; crates.io inspire 0.2.0 (published 2026-02-15) is the only surviving copy. Its secure_128_d2048 uses the 2-CRT moduli [268369921, 249561089] (q ~ 2^56), which is exactly the parameter set Raven's fork replaced with a single-prime q = 2^60 - 2^14 + 1, calling it under-provisioned. Benchmarked through a driver crate in this repo, since the published crate ships no BenchReport emitter.
